deals.comment: Kibum Kim, an officer of Valuepotion Co., Ltd., acquired additional 7.5% stake in Valuepotion Co., Ltd. for approximately KRW 100 million on August 1, 2016. Kibum Kim acquired 1000 shares at KRW 102,000 per share.

podotree, inc agreed to acquire Valuepotion Co., Ltd from group of sellers for KRW 4.5 billion on November 6, 2017. On November 7, 2017, podotree, inc signed a contract with group of sellers. Under the terms, podotree, inc acquire 0.02 million shares at KRW 228,264 per share. The Board of Directors of Kakao Corp. resolved the transaction on November 6, 2017. The transaction consideration is expected to be paid on November 20, 2017 and the transaction is expected to close on November 20, 2017.

deals.target: Kakaopage Business Segment of Kakao Corp.
deals.comment: podotree, inc. agreed to acquire Kakaopage business segment of Kakao Corp. (KOSE:A035720) for KRW 100 billion on April 18, 2018. podotree, inc. will issue 2.89 million shares at KRW 34,552 per share as consideration. The Board of Directors passed a resolution for the transaction on April 18, 2018. The consideration shares are expected to be issued on September 1, 2018.
Kakao Page Corp. acquired 20.03% stake in Samyang CNC Co.,Ltd for KRW 2.4 billion on November 30, 2018. Kakao Page Corp. acquired 2003 shares in Samyang CNC Co.,Ltd. for KRW 1.18 million per share.
Kakao Page Corp. acquired the remaining 30% stake in Samyang CNC Co.,Ltd. for KRW 24 billion on January 15, 2021. Kakao Page Corp. acquired 3000 shares of Samyang CNC for KRW 8 million per share.
